title: Excel for drilling and well engineers
why: Specialist well-engineering software does the heavy lifting, but drilling teams still rely on spreadsheets for quick checks, cost and time estimates, and reporting between systems.
what_is_different: Well-engineering spreadsheets deal with depth-based data (MD/TVD), survey calculations, pressure gradients and time–depth curves. Outputs feed AFEs, well programmes and regulatory reports, so traceability matters.
